headings: How to Regain Consistency with Facebook Ads After the Andromeda Update
The Three-Part System That Works Now
Ready to Stop Wasting Ad Spend?
paragraphs: The Andromeda update shook things up. Here’s the step-by-step framework to bring structure—and results—back to your ad campaigns.
Think of your ad strategy as a funnel with three campaigns. Each one has its role:
The Andromeda update made one thing clear: your creative does the targeting.
Tip: Refresh creatives weekly. Creative fatigue kills performance faster than poor targeting.
Manual bidding helps you stay profitable while scaling:
Consistency comes from repetition. Here’s your rhythm:
The Andromeda update didn’t kill Facebook ads—it just changed the rules. With the right structure, creative, and cost control, you can get your momentum back.
list_items: Prospecting – Find the Winners : Launch a CBO campaign with broad targeting, start lean (~$30/day), test 5–8 creatives weekly, and promote winners.
Remarketing – Build Trust : Target warm audiences, use testimonials and FAQs, dedicate ~20% of daily spend.
Scaling – Maximize Return : Move proven ads into a scaling campaign, start with $100–$200/day, and raise budgets 5–10% gradually.
Research First : Define who your customer is, what problem they need solved, and why your offer is unique.
Creative Angles : Pain points, desires, objections, and promises.
Formats : Rotate static images, UGC, videos, and before/after shots.
Copy Framework : Hook → Pain → Relief → Process → Proof → CTA.
Set bid caps just below your break-even CPA.
Raise bids slowly in small increments.
Ensure budgets are about 20× your target CPA.

g3_corrections.cause: BeautifulSoup default decoding mis-detected the saved Andromeda UTF-8 body (non-ASCII characters rendered as mojibake, failing md containment); index_counts compared list fields against derived ints without len()
g3_corrections.fix: explicit from_encoding='utf-8' (the saved bytes are UTF-8, as the product's own prepared output shows); index counts normalized with len() for list fields

g3_corrections.cause: the prepared md renders the Andromeda list items with markdown emphasis ('**Prospecting – Find the Winners** : …'), so the derived raw text is not a literal substring — the emphasis markers interleave identical words in order
g3_corrections.fix: emphasis markers (**) removed from the md text before containment; words and order otherwise compared exactly; the rendering is recorded in the result

g3_corrections.cause: the assessment key was named 't09_authored_claims_unsupported_count', asserting the keyword hits were unsupported conclusions; the instrument only detects keyword matches without a nearby caveat — adjudication is the Executor's, recorded in the report
